entities.name: Kim Jong-suk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kim Jong-suk was a North Korean revolutionary, anti-Japanese guerrilla, Communist activist, the first wife of North Korean leader Kim Il Sung, the mother of former leader Kim Jong Il and grandmother of current leader Kim Jong Un.
